content.value_statement: Slack GIFs and animated emoji must meet strict size, dimension, and color limits. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code reusable Python helpers to build, optimize, and validate animations.
actual_capabilities: Builds frame sequences for shake, bounce, spin, pulse, fade, zoom, morph, slide, and other animation styles.
Saves GIFs with color quantization, duplicate frame removal, and emoji optimization settings.
Validates GIF file size, dimensions, duration, frame count, and Slack readiness.
Provides drawing helpers for emojis, text outlines, shapes, shadows, gradients, particles, and impact effects.
Offers reusable composition patterns for message GIFs and compact animated emoji.
limitations: Requires Python image libraries such as Pillow, imageio, and numpy in the runtime environment.
Does not upload GIFs to Slack or manage Slack workspace permissions.
Very small animated emoji may require multiple optimization passes to stay under 64 KB.
Generated visuals depend on available fonts and emoji rendering support on the host system.

use_cases.title: Build Team Reaction GIFs
use_cases.description: Create short Slack message GIFs for launches, wins, reminders, and team rituals.

use_cases.title: Create Custom Animated Emoji
use_cases.description: Design compact 128x128 emoji loops and validate them against Slack size limits.

use_cases.title: Prototype Motion Concepts
use_cases.description: Combine reusable motion primitives to test visual ideas before polishing final assets.

prompt_templates.title: Make a Simple Emoji
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 128x128 Slack animated emoji of a waving hand with a simple bounce. Keep it under 64 KB and validate it.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Message GIF
prompt_templates.prompt: Make a 480x480 Slack message GIF where a rocket slides across the frame, leaves sparkles, and ends with outlined text that says LAUNCH.

prompt_templates.title: Combine Motion Effects
prompt_templates.prompt: Combine a bounce, impact flash, and shake effect into a Slack-ready celebration GIF. Explain the frame phases and optimization choices.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Optimized Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a reusable workflow for a reaction morph from a surprised face to a party emoji. Include a fallback plan if the GIF exceeds Slack size limits.

output_examples.input: Create a compact animated emoji that pulses with excitement.
output_examples.output: A 128x128 pulsing emoji GIF with 12 frames, a reduced color palette, and a Slack size validation note.

output_examples.input: Make a team win GIF with movement, impact, and bold text.
output_examples.output: A 480x480 message GIF with a bouncing object, flash effect, outlined WIN text, and optimized color settings.

output_examples.input: Turn two reaction emoji into a smooth transition loop.
output_examples.output: A short morph animation that crossfades between the reactions and reports whether it is ready for Slack emoji use.

best_practices: Start with the target use: emoji or message GIF, then choose size, FPS, and frame count.
Validate early and after each optimization pass, especially for 64 KB animated emoji.
Prefer simple shapes, limited colors, and short loops when optimizing for Slack emoji.
anti_patterns: Building long, high-FPS emoji loops before checking file size.
Using gradients and too many colors in 64 KB animated emoji.
Assuming the skill uploads files to Slack or replaces workspace review steps.

faq.question: Can this skill create Slack animated emoji?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes 128x128 emoji workflows and validation helpers for Slack size limits.

faq.question: Does it upload GIFs directly to Slack?
faq.answer: No. It creates and validates GIF files, but users still upload them through Slack.

faq.question: Which Python libraries are needed?
faq.answer: The toolkit expects Pillow, imageio, imageio-ffmpeg, and numpy to be available.

faq.question: Can it make larger message GIFs?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports 480x480 message GIFs with higher file size targets than emoji.

faq.question: How does it reduce file size?
faq.answer: It can reduce colors, remove duplicate frames, lower frame count, and apply emoji optimization settings.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, or Claude Code customize animations?
faq.answer: Yes. The examples are composable, so agents can combine motion primitives for custom GIF requests.
